title: 4521-ESP-AGE-00-45-0002 R0A
summary:
- Specification for supply of instruments for the Solana project
- Definitions include Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, Owner
- Scope includes all cables, gaskets, manifolds as identified in main specification
- Supplier responsible for delivery to selected Fabricators or jobsite
- Owner can require alternative billing cycles
- Confidentiality and proprietary information restrictions
- All materials must meet specific standards.
- Owner can request non-standard billing cycles.
- Cable glands have specific material and protection requirements.
- Dimensions for cable glands are provided in inches.
